第四章被揍还一副冷漠的脸

恶婆婆很常见，把儿媳妇害死的也有，只是没见过娘家人能第一时间来报公安的。

大多都是先谈条件，谈崩后再来个鱼死网破。瞅瞅这家当爹当伯伯的，能像女人一样痛哭流涕，这位受害者至少有疼爱她的家人。

“行了，我们这边记录好了，先去见一下受害人看看伤情。”

“谢谢公安同志。”

冉和平这边很是顺利，魏淑萍那边更是热闹非常。

顾城所待的煤厂，工人上千人，三个女人拿着沾血的裤子举过头顶喊冤，几十年难遇。

没用多久，该来的都来了，不该来的人家想看个热闹又能如何。

顾城远远看到丈母娘眼里快速闪过一丝嫌恶，此人是出了名的泼妇。只是在听清楚她在喊什么时脸色大变，怎么可能？

“顾城来了，赶紧让让。”

像是领导来视察工作，人人行注目礼，人人列队欢迎。

“妈，你怎么来了，是出了什么事吗？赶紧起来，有什么话咱回家说。”

“出什么事了，你亲娘把你媳妇打流产了，怀了三个月的孩子已经是一滩血了。

都这会儿了还和老娘装，我养的好好的闺女出嫁五个月，浑身没一处好地方。

大伙都来看看，我女婿最会装瞎，媳妇被亲娘打了一身伤就是装作看不见。”

孩子掉了，顾城是如何也没想到的，但看到被众人围观，必须马上平息丈母娘的怒火。

噗通，顾城直接跪在魏淑萍面前，常年冰冷的脸终于带上了痛苦的神色。

“妈，我是真没想到闫嫣会流产。”

“呸，给老娘装什么装，你想不到？你媳妇浑身带着伤你是咋半夜脱她衣服的？”

冉老二媳妇赵宝珠可是出了名的泼，最看不得装相的男人，更何况伤的还是闫嫣。

“哈哈哈哈，就是，没听说嫁过去五个月怀了三个月，难道顾城睡媳妇时不用脱衣服？”

“啥没想到，就是像他丈母娘说的装瞎，之前还真没看出来是这种人。”

Chapter 4: Even after being beaten, he still had an indifferent face

Evil mothers-in-law are very common, and there are also those who kill their daughters-in-law, but I have never seen the mother-in-law come to the police immediately.

Most of the time, the terms are negotiated first, and then the deal is broken down.Look at this father and uncle who can cry like a woman. This victim at least has a family that loves her.

"Okay, we've recorded it here. Let's go see the victim first to see the extent of his injuries."

"Thank you, comrade police."

Ran Heping's side went very smoothly, and Wei Shuping's side was even more lively.

The coal factory where Gu Cheng worked had thousands of workers. Three women held their bloody pants above their heads and cried out for injustice. This was a rare sight in decades.

It didn’t take long before everyone who was supposed to come came, and those who weren’t supposed to come wanted to watch the fun, so what?

From a distance, Gu Cheng saw a flash of disgust flash in his mother-in-law's eyes. This person was known as a shrew.Just when he heard what she was shouting, his expression changed drastically. How could that be possible?

"Gu Cheng is here, give way quickly."

For example, when a leader comes to inspect the work, everyone pays attention and lines up to welcome him.

"Mom, why are you here? Did something happen? Get up quickly. If you have anything to say, let's go home and talk."

"What happened? Your mother aborted your daughter-in-law, and the child who was three months pregnant was already a pool of blood.

Nowadays, I am still pretending to be an old lady. My well-raised daughter has been married for five months and there is not a single good thing about her body.

Everyone, come and see, my son-in-law is the best at pretending to be blind, and my daughter-in-law was beaten and injured by her own mother and just pretended not to see."

Gu Cheng never expected that the child would be lost, but when he saw the crowd watching, he had to calm down his mother-in-law's anger immediately.

Poof, Gu Cheng knelt directly in front of Wei Shuping, his face that had always been cold finally took on a look of pain.

"Mom, I really didn't expect Yan Yan to have a miscarriage."

"Bah, you can't think of what to put on for me? How did you take off her clothes in the middle of the night when your wife is covered in injuries?"

Ran Lao's second daughter-in-law, Zhao Baozhu, was notoriously domineering, and she despised men who put on pretense, not to mention that it was Yan Yan who was hurt.

"Hahahaha, that's right, I didn't hear that I was pregnant for three months after five months of marriage. Doesn't Gu Cheng need to take off his clothes when sleeping with his wife?"

"I didn't expect him. He was just pretending to be blind, as his mother-in-law said. I really didn't realize he was this kind of person before."
